full_prompt_en: The image is a square cinematic photograph of two people resting beside a grounded capsule under cold floodlights. The large pale gray capsule dominates the left two thirds of the frame. Its rounded upper shell curves into a near-vertical side with seams, small dark panels, vents, and a tall open-looking recess on the right side of the hull. A broad dark lower rim sits close to rough gravel, making the object feel heavy and grounded rather than airborne. In front of it, one person in a pale padded suit sits low with knees bent, turned toward a second person seated farther right on a narrow chair or case. The second person also wears a pale outfit and leans forward, looking down toward the hands. Their small figures are dwarfed by the capsule's curved mass. Loose cables and small equipment pieces lie across the stony foreground. A pair of warm lamps glints near the top of the capsule, while a high cluster of bright square floodlights glows through blue haze at the upper right. The rest of the background dissolves into dark night and fog, with no clear horizon. The viewpoint is low and slightly oblique, so the hull sweeps from the left edge into the center and the people occupy a quiet pocket of space at the right. Cool blue-gray light washes the hull and suits; deeper charcoal shadows gather under the capsule and inside its recesses. Fine grit on the ground and soft mist in the air give the image contrasting textures. The overall composition feels still and expectant, balancing a monumental engineered curve against a small human pause in an open, dim environment.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一张方形电影感摄影：两人在冷色泛光灯下停靠的舱体旁休息。巨大的浅灰舱体占据左侧三分之二。圆弧顶壳转入近乎竖直的侧面，其上有接缝、小暗面板、通风孔以及船体右侧一道高高的开口状凹处。宽阔暗色底缘贴近粗糙碎石，使它显得沉重落地，而非悬浮空中。前面，一位穿浅色加厚服装的人低坐、双膝弯起，转向右边较远处坐在窄椅或箱子上的第二人。第二人也穿浅色衣服，向前俯身，低头看着双手。两人的小身形被舱体曲面衬得很小。松散电缆和小件器材横在石砾前景。舱体顶端附近有一对暖色小灯发亮，右上方一组明亮方形泛光灯穿过蓝雾发光。背景其余部分融进暗夜与雾气，没有清楚地平线。视点低而略偏斜，使船壳从左画边扫入中央，两人则占据右侧安静的一口空间。冷蓝灰光洗过船体和服装；深炭影聚在舱下与凹口内部。地面的细砂砾与空气中的柔雾带来对照肌理。整体构图静止而有所期待，以巨大的工程曲面与昏暗开放环境里短暂停顿的小人物相平衡。
style_prompt_en: Cinematic photography uses a low oblique viewpoint, monumental curved massing, and small subdued focal accents in a broad dark setting. Blue-gray haze softens distance, while cold high floodlight blooms create localized bright patches and long gentle gradients across matte pale surfaces. Small warm points remain separate near the upper area. Charcoal recesses and a heavy lower shadow ground the main volume. Foreground grit, loose fine lines, and scattered dark marks provide tactile scale against smooth engineered curves. The framing places most visual weight to one side and preserves a quieter pocket on the other. Depth emerges through overlapping forms, fog, and strong size contrast, with a hushed, anticipatory mood.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感摄影采用低而偏斜的视点、巨大的曲面体块与宽阔暗场中收敛的小焦点。蓝灰薄雾柔化远处，高处冷泛光的光晕制造局部亮片和落在浅色哑光表面上的长缓渐变。少数暖色小光点分隔在上部。炭黑凹处与沉重的下方阴影让主要体积落地。前景砂砾、松散细线和散落暗痕在平顺工程曲线前提供可触尺度。画幅把多数视觉重量放到一侧，另一侧保留较安静的空间。纵深来自形体遮叠、雾气与强烈大小对比，气氛沉静而有所期待。
theme_en: Two people resting beside a grounded capsule under cold floodlights
theme_zh: 两人在冷色泛光灯下停靠的舱体旁休息
name: Alfonso Cuaron
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
